parts:
First, ignore the stuff on the left of AM, RM and CU. Let's just look at that part of the model.

You are fitting a confidmatory factor analysis with three latent variables (AM, RM, CU) and you have three indicators. Because you have three indicators, You have 3 moments (covariances) going into that part of the model. And you are estimating 9 parameters. You can't estimate more parameters than you have moments, that's the first rule of identification. of SEMs 

Jeremy
